'''Krikit''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Upon the Jawa's request, a traveling individual freed several of his friends from [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]].
